correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Binet/Lucas identity, five-root characteristic polynomial and discriminant 2^4*3^2*5^10; Vandermonde over Z/p^e is invertible at p>=7. Constant mode forces p^e|k; t-1 is unit (norm 5), so the other modes vanish exactly when t^k=1. The order h_p divides p±1, and binomial lifting proves t^k=1 mod p^{v_p(k)} when h_p|k. Upper bound from constant mode proves the exact exponent. Independent finite check 1<=k<=400 corroborates; no finite-only inference.

Arithmetic order detects irregular prime factors such as 7 at k=56 and 13 at k=91, with exact multiplicities.
